context: Merchant Dashboard redesign for Dynopay non-custodial crypto payment gateway. Fixed, opinionated layout following the command-centre principle: State → Attention → Money → Trend → Activity.

core_principles: Large tabular numerals using monospace font for all financial metrics.
One accent color (#4F46E5 light / #818CF8 dark) strictly reserved for interactive actions and primary CTAs.
Semantic colors strictly reserved for payment state machine states (green paid, amber confirming/underpaid, red expired/failed, grey refunded).
Depth created through subtle surface layering and elevation rather than border overload.
Fixed opinionated layout without user customization.

zone_1_header.name: Header & Controls
anatomy: NEW 'Live pulse' chip: shows gateway state ('3 payments confirming · last paid 4 min ago' or 'Quiet — last payment Tue 14:02'). Turns amber/red only when gateway is degraded and expands to detail service.
Global range control pills: Today · 7d · 30d · 90d · 12m · Custom

pulse_chip_states.healthy: Subtle green indicator dot, muted text background, quiet presence
pulse_chip_states.confirming: Amber pulse dot + live count of confirming payments
pulse_chip_states.degraded: Amber/Red expanding banner listing affected service (e.g. TRON RPC delayed)

zone_2_attention_feed.name: Needs Attention Task Feed
zone_2_attention_feed.behavior: Renders ONLY when non-empty. Ordered list, max 5 visible + 'Show all' toggle button.
zone_2_attention_feed.row_anatomy: Icon · One plain sentence · One action button
priority_hierarchy: 1. Security & Compliance blockers (KYC due, 2FA missing, wallet changes frozen, password missing)
2. Money exceptions (underpaid awaiting decision, overpaid, expired checkouts today, payments confirming >60 min)
3. Configuration gaps (accepted coin without payout wallet, failing webhooks N times/24h, API key >12m, product out of stock)
4. At most one growth nudge (claim handle, referral reward, fee-free credit)
zone_2_attention_feed.severity_design: Subtle left accent indicator or muted icon color; avoids alarm-color overload across the row.

zone_3_money_now.name: Money Now Tiles
zone_3_money_now.layout: 3 tiles in one horizontal row (desktop) / horizontally swipeable row (phone)

tiles.title: Settled in range
tiles.content: Gross amount → Net after fees (large tabular mono), delta % vs previous period, payment count

tiles.title: In flight
tiles.content: Amount detected on-chain awaiting confirmations + count. Tap → Transactions filtered confirming

tiles.title: Forwarded to your wallets
tiles.content: Amount forwarded in range split by asset as mini stacked bars, last forward timestamp, auto-convert note ('Converted to USDT: $x'). Tap → Payouts

zone_4_trend.name: Trend & Checkout Health
components: Volume chart with toggle buttons: Volume / Payments / Avg ticket
Asset mix legend toggle embedded inside chart header card
Beneath chart: Checkout health metric line (Completion rate created → paid, Median confirmation time, Underpaid + expired rate, each with delta %)
zone_4_trend.phone_behavior: Trend chart defaults to 7d timeframe on mobile screens

zone_5_activity.name: Activity Grid
zone_5_activity.layout: Two equal columns on desktop / vertically stacked on phone

columns.title: Recent Payments
columns.content: 8 rows desktop / 5 rows mobile (+ 'See all' link). Row anatomy: Amount (mono tabular), Asset icon, Status chip (confirming/paid/underpaid/overpaid/expired/refunded), Customer, Time, Tx link

columns.title: Top Links & Products in Range
columns.content: List of top items. Row anatomy: Item name, Paid count, Volume (mono tabular)

zone_6_plan_growth.name: Plan & Growth
zone_6_plan_growth.layout: One collapsible row at the very bottom, collapsed by default
zone_6_plan_growth.collapsed_content: 'Starter tier · 1.5% · $x of $10k to Growth (1%)' with expand arrow
zone_6_plan_growth.expanded_content: Detailed breakdown of current fee tier, progress bar toward next tier, and upgrade details

new_merchant_state.trigger: Active until the merchant receives their first crypto payment.
new_merchant_state.zone_2_override: Zone 2 transforms into the 'Getting-started' onboarding checklist.
new_merchant_state.zones_3_to_5_override: Zones 3, 4, and 5 render as a faded preview overlay captioned 'fills in after your first payment'.

mobile.activity: Stacked single column, 5 rows max with 'See all' button

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle surface fill change (1px lighter/darker) with 150ms ease-in-out transition.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-in upward slide for zones (fade in 200ms, translate-y 4px).
motion_and_interactions.a11y: Respects prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast ratios for all money text and status chips.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.file_extension: Use .js or .jsx file extensions for React components in this project environment.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.avoid_ai_slop: Avoid generic dark gradients and flashy card borders. Maintain crisp hairline borders #E2E8F0 / rgba(255,255,255,0.08) and flat solid surfaces.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, links, cards) MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.
